material_findings.title: Control 2 predicate expects C-live-step latched before SIGNAL_TERM; bash runs the pending TERM trap before the next command, so SIGNAL_TERM is latched first
material_findings.blocks: Stage 1 grant on exact frozen bytes
material_findings.mechanism: signal_session TERMs the session leader (stub bash) first, then the timeout group; sleep dies, timeout exits 143, foreground subshell at lib 85 completes; bash executes the pending trap before `local rc=$?` (restoring $?), so on_signal -> block SIGNAL_TERM 143 sets FIRST_FAIL before block C-live-step at lib 98. Record: first_failure.step=SIGNAL_TERM, observed_exit=143, later C-live-step block. Predicate 75 misses -> driver exit 94 -> V4 by packet rule.
material_findings.minimal_closure: Predicate/prose only: 75 expect SIGNAL_TERM; 76 observed 143; 77 require a C-live-step block; reword request 65 and stub comment 34-35. New predicate hash + manifest; launcher/lib/runner/stub logic unchanged. Do not change on_signal/step ordering.
